name: FH9
driverConfig: 1DD + 6BA (13.6mm DLC dynamic + Knowles DFK ×2 mid + SWFK treble)
cons: Isolation is reduced due to semi-open design
Weight is higher than closed shells
insight: FH9 is one of FiiO’s most ambitious hybrids, combining a large DLC dynamic with six Knowles BAs in a semi-open titanium shell. The result is a spacious presentation with strong technical performance. Reviewers frequently highlight the soundstage and the excellent cable/accessory package.
